pages.title: Introduction
pages.content:
## What is a gouw?

A **gouw** (Dutch for "county") is a piece of land you claim on the server — one chunk at a time. Inside a gouw, only the people it belongs to can build, open containers or fight. Gouw is the in-house replacement for the old Lands plugin, and every Lands claim was carried over automatically the first time Gouw started.

Since version 0.4 a gouw is also a little **town**: the owner is the **mayor**, the people they invite are **residents**, and trusted residents can be promoted to **officers**. Towns share a **bank**, can **buy extra chunk space** with it, and the mayor hands out **rights per resident** (build, chests, doors, mobs, pvp, claim).

* [Gouw — Land Claims](/wiki?page=gouw) — how protection works and what your limits are
* [Gouw — Towns & Rights](/wiki?page=gouw-towns) — mayors, officers, residents, rights and the town bank
* [Gouw Commands](/wiki?page=gouw-commands) — the full `/gouw` reference

pages.title: Gouw — Land Claims
pages.content:
Gouw claims **chunks** (16×16 blocks). Stand in a chunk and run `/gouw claim` and it's yours: the action bar tells you, and `/gouw border` traces the outline of the whole gouw with golden particles.

**What a gouw protects.** Outsiders can't break or place blocks, can't fill or empty buckets, and can't open anything — chests and barrels fall under the **Containers** right, doors, beds and buttons under **Interact**. They can't attack animals or mobs living there, and they can't fight players inside either. Even explosions — creeper or TNT — won't chew holes in claimed ground, and pistons are stopped at the border. Staff with the bypass toggle are always allowed through.

**Who may do what.** The owner (the **mayor**) can always do everything. Officers can too. Residents each carry their own set of rights — see [Towns & Rights](/wiki?page=gouw-towns) for how the mayor hands those out per person.

**Limits.** Every player may claim **16 chunks** by default (staff can change this in the config, and rank groups get more through the `gouw.chunks.<n>` permission). Beyond that, a town can simply **buy** more: `/gouw buy 1` raises the gouw's limit from the town bank (250 per chunk at the time of writing). `/gouw autoclaim 2` claims a 5×5 square around you in one go, which is the quickest way to lay out a base plot. `/gouw unclaim` gives the chunk you're standing in back (mayor and officers); `/gouw unclaim all` gives up everything you own.

**Finding your way.** `/gouw info` shows the gouw under your feet, `/gouw list` shows your town's numbers, and `/gouw near [r]` lists gouws around you. Entering or leaving a gouw shows an action bar and a pulse along the chunk border. Claims of inactive players are only released if staff enable `expire-inactive-days` — on iekcorbar that's currently off (0), so claims stay yours.

Old Lands claims were imported on Gouw's first start and are stored as plain JSON (`plugins/Gouw/claims.json`) — if a claim from the Lands days looks off, tell staff; they can inspect and fix it with `/gouw admin` tools.

pages.title: Gouw — Towns & Rights
pages.content:
Since 0.4 every gouw doubles as a small town. No alliances, no wars — just people building something together.


* [Who's who](/wiki?page=gouw-towns-who-s-who)
* [Rights, per resident](/wiki?page=gouw-towns-rights-per-resident)
* [The town bank](/wiki?page=gouw-towns-the-town-bank)
* [Growing the town](/wiki?page=gouw-towns-growing-the-town)

pages.title: Who's who
pages.content:
* **Mayor** — the player who claimed the first chunk. The mayor runs everything: invites and removes members, hands out rights, promotes officers, buys chunks with town money, and releases the whole gouw. Only the mayor can promote and demote.
* **Officer** — a promoted resident. Officers manage almost everything the mayor can (claim, unclaim chunks, invite, remove, rights, bank withdrawals, buying) but can't promote, demote or release the whole gouw.
* **Resident** — an invited member who **accepted the invite**, with a personal set of rights. Residents live in the town; whether they may claim new chunks is one of those rights.

Since version 0.5 **an invite is an invite, not a membership**: the mayor sends it, the target gets a chat message with **[Accept]** / **[Decline]** (offline players are notified when they next join) and only then becomes a resident. Being a resident of other towns alongside your own gouw is normal and allowed — neighbours regularly welcome each other, and you can be a member of several towns at once. Your menu and `/gouw info` always act on the town you are standing in.

Back to [Gouw — Towns & Rights](/wiki?page=gouw-towns)

pages.title: Rights, per resident
pages.content:
Six rights can be granted to each resident individually:

| Right | Lets the resident… |
|---|---|
| **Build** | break and place blocks, use buckets |
| **Containers** | open chests, barrels and similar storage |
| **Interact** | use doors, beds, buttons and levers |
| **Mobs** | attack animals and mobs in the gouw |
| **PvP** | attack other players inside |
| **Claim** | add new chunks to the town (`/gouw claim`) |

New residents start with the town's **defaults** (everything except Claim). The mayor or an officer opens `/gouw menu` → **Residents** → clicks a resident's head: six toggle buttons appear, plus promote/demote and remove. Changing the defaults (menu → **New-resident rights**) does not silently rewrite residents who already have their own personal settings.

Back to [Gouw — Towns & Rights](/wiki?page=gouw-towns)

pages.title: The town bank
pages.content:
Every resident may **deposit and withdraw** through `/gouw bank`, `/gouw deposit <amount>` and `/gouw withdraw <amount>`, or with the buttons on the menu's **Bank** page. The bank is where a town keeps shared money: building funds, border expansions, that bridge everyone wanted.

Heads-up: **Gouw never pays salaries.** Your income comes from the job you picked during onboarding (Jobs Reborn / the quest tutorial) — gouw only holds and spends what residents put in.

Back to [Gouw — Towns & Rights](/wiki?page=gouw-towns)

pages.title: Growing the town
pages.content:
`/gouw buy [n]` buys *n* extra chunk slots for the town, paid from the bank (250 per chunk at the time of writing, with a server cap per town). The new limit applies to the whole gouw, so `/gouw info` shows e.g. `34/40 chunks (30 rank + 10 bought)`. Claiming into a bigger town is then simply `/gouw claim` (officers) or with the CLAIM right (residents).

[Back to the Introduction](/wiki?page=gouw-intro) · [Land Claims](/wiki?page=gouw) · [Commands](/wiki?page=gouw-commands)

pages.title: Gouw Commands
pages.content:
All gouw commands live under one command — `/gouw` (short: `/g`, alias `/claim`). Typing it with no arguments opens the **gouw menu**, a clickable inventory screen with pages for Residents, Rights, the Bank and staff tools.

**Land**

* `/gouw claim` — claim the chunk you're standing in (mayor/officers; residents only with the CLAIM right).
* `/gouw autoclaim <radius>` — claim every free chunk within <radius> of where you stand, in one go. radius 1 = 3×3, radius 2 = 5×5.
* `/gouw buy [n]` — buy n extra chunk slots for the town, paid from the town bank.
* `/gouw unclaim` — give back the chunk under your feet (mayor/officers). `/gouw unclaim all` releases your whole gouw (mayor only).
* `/gouw border` — a golden particle outline of the gouw you're standing in.

**Town**

* `/gouw invite <name>` — send an invite (aliases: `/gouw trust`). It stays open until the target accepts - owning your own gouw or living in other towns is no problem.
* `/gouw accept` / `/gouw decline` — take or drop every open invite for you (the chat notice has clickable buttons too).
* `/gouw kick <name>` — remove a resident; residents may also leave themselves with `/gouw leave`.
* `/gouw promote <name>` / `/gouw demote <name>` — resident ↔ officer (mayor only).
* `/gouw members` — list the residents of your gouw with their roles and rights.
* `/gouw rename <name>` — name your town (shown in enter messages).

**Bank**

* `/gouw bank` — balance, chunk numbers and the price of the next chunk.
* `/gouw deposit <amount>` / `/gouw withdraw <amount>` — every resident deposits and withdraws; withdrawals need the money to be in the bank, of course.

**Looking around**

* `/gouw info` — the gouw under your feet: who owns it, size vs limit, residents, bank.
* `/gouw list` — your own town's numbers plus server-wide totals.
* `/gouw near [r]` — the gouws within r chunks, with their distance.

Staff (permission `gouw.admin`):

* `/gouw admin delete <name>` — remove a player's claims (e.g. after a confirmed request).
* `/gouw admin import [force]` — re-run the old Lands import; `/gouw admin reload` re-reads the config.
* `/gouw admin bypass [on|off]` — toggle walking through and building in *any* gouw while inspecting.
* `/gouw admin addchunks <player> <n>` / `buychunks <player> <n> <cost>` — grant personal bonus chunks (the contract-NPC flow; personal, not town).

> Jobs are not part of Gouw: your job comes from the onboarding tutorial (Jobs Reborn) and is paid there. The town bank only holds what residents deposit.
